who.title: WHO IS XAVIGIL FILM?
who.p1: Xavigil Film is more than a name; it’s a global narrative woven with the vibrant energy of South Korea. I’m Franco Gil, better known as Xavi or Xavier, an international influencer with an unwavering passion for connecting cultures through Korean fashion, travel, and lifestyle. From Seoul’s runways to the most authentic corners of its culture, my mission is to create content that not only inspires but builds bridges between visionary brands and a global audience captivated by the Hallyu wave.
who.p2: With deep knowledge of the Korean market and a cinematic aesthetic sensibility, I transform stories into impactful visual experiences, collaborating with brands seeking authentic connections at the heart of Asia and beyond. Ready to tell your story?

testimonials.title: WHAT BRANDS SAY ABOUT XAVIGIL FILM
testimonials.p1: "Working with Xavier Gil was a truly rewarding experience. His creativity and unique vision successfully presented the MIXSOON philosophy and our skincare products in an exceptional way. The content he created not only met but exceeded our expectations, showing his audience how to achieve the coveted 'glass skin' effect. We are delighted with the reception and the final result."
testimonials.p2: "We deeply appreciate the collaboration with Xavier Gil. It was a pleasure working with him and we are very satisfied with the outcome. His work reflects a genuine passion for skincare. We look forward to future opportunities to work together!"
